items.title: Deadline to withdraw from the cleaning subscription contract
items.quote: Innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Vertragsschluss können Sie sich ohne Begründung wieder von diesem Vertrag lösen, indem Sie ihn widerrufen.
items.computation: Contract was concluded at the sales stand on 21.11.2026, and this written confirmation was received directly on the same day, so the 14-day withdrawal period under §355 BGB starts with the day of contract conclusion. Per §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so day 1 is 22.11.2026 and day 14 falls on 05.12.2026. 05.12.2026 is a Saturday. Because this is a declaration deadline, §193 BGB shifts the end of the period to the next working day: Sunday 06.12.2026 is also non-working, so the deadline moves to Monday 07.12.2026. Note the letter states it suffices that the withdrawal is sent (not received) within the period.

items.title: Start of cleaning subscription service
items.computation: The letter states the service start date directly as a calendar date; no counting is required.

warnings: This contract was concluded on the spot at a promotional sales stand in a shopping center; such door-to-door/stand sales situations are a common setting for high-pressure selling, so double-check that the agreed service, price and duration match what was actually discussed before the withdrawal period expires.
The letter gives no information about a minimum contract term or a notice period for ordinary termination after the first term; confirm these details separately if they matter to you.
